_comment: The content-gap register's settings (brief §73), read by tools/make_register.py, the Pages tab and the Ask bar alike. min_asks_month: a page enters the retrieval list when typed questions named it this often in a month; min_answers: a page enters the content list when this many answers cited it in the period; statuses: the fixed list the status file may use; owners: who the evidence and status files belong to. stale_before: a cited page last changed before this date is stale. retrieval_not_found / retrieval_reached: a named page enters the retrieval list when its not-found share is at least the first, or when the page or a sibling in its category was cited in under the second of the questions naming it. kinds missing-page and signpost (brief §75) are topic rows with no URL: a subject with no page, or one the site will never carry where the right answer is an organisation; their evidence comes from register-themes.json until the topic layer computes it. topic_min_turns / topic_not_found / topic_partial (brief §75): a lexicon topic with that many typed questions in the period enters as missing-page at that not-found share, or as detail at that partial share.

owners.status: Alan O'Connor (until a content-side name is given)
